title: Private Willamette Valley Wine Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Jeff Davies has 30+ years of guiding Willamette Valley Wine Tours. I have top reviews on TripAdvisor, Google and Yelp for Private Tours & Group Tours. My commentary will give guests insider knowledge and our winery visits will give guests memorable encounters with winery staff. I can specialize the tour to suit your taste. I prefer wineries with amazing wine and beautiful views but, it's your choice.

You can choose your wineries and can also pick them . Also, there are lunch choices to be made.
